metadata.description: 20-prompt balanced suite: 10 should trigger, 10 should not trigger. Non-triggering prompts are deliberately adjacent boundary cases (prompt rewriting/engineering, API credential provisioning, live benchmark runs, general coding, merge conflict resolution) to evaluate boundary precision.

cases.prompt: Assign a model for this prompt: Refactor our multi-service authentication architecture
Select the optimal model and tier for generating basic unit tests for this utility module
Configure opencode model governance to minimize token cost for our finder agent
I need an opencode launch command with --model for running this security audit task
Reconcile my global ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json with this repo's project opencode.json to choose the right LLM
Optimize our model choice for cost vs. intelligence using the balanced mode
Determine the LLM tier and launch command to run a syntax check across these markdown files
Patch our opencode.json so the evaluator subagent runs on a frontier reasoning model
What provider and model should run this prompt under a result_maximized policy?
Profile the cognitive complexity of this task specification and recommend an opencode model
Rewrite this prompt to make it clearer and reduce hallucination
Help me improve the wording of this system prompt for our customer support bot
Set up and provision Google Cloud Vertex AI API credentials and service account keys
Store our Anthropic API key securely in our shell environment variables
Run an MMLU benchmark evaluation suite to compare Claude 3.5 Sonnet against GPT-4o
Evaluate our agent's accuracy and latency across 100 historical queries
Write a Python script to calculate Fibonacci numbers
Resolve the merge conflict in opencode.json between main and feature branch
Add a retry mechanism with exponential backoff to our HTTP client
Deploy our application to Google Kubernetes Engine using Terraform
